scripts.gen: pnpm --filter @oa/shared build && pnpm run version:emit && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/emit-tool-manifest.ts && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/emit-skill.ts && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/emit-upgrade.ts
scripts.build: pnpm run gen && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/emit-consent-template.ts && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/emit-email-templates.ts && pnpm --filter @oa/dashboard run --if-present build && pnpm --filter @oa/render build --if-present && pnpm --filter @oa/runtime build --if-present && node scripts/assemble-assets.mjs && node scripts/check-worker-size.mjs
scripts.test: pnpm run gen && vitest run --exclude "test/smoke/**" --passWithNoTests && vitest run -c vitest.node.config.ts && vitest run -c vitest.xt.config.ts
scripts.test:authz: pnpm run gen && vitest run -c vitest.authz.config.ts
scripts.test:cpu: pnpm run gen && vitest run -c vitest.cpu.config.ts && vitest run -c vitest.codecpu.config.ts
scripts.bench: pnpm run gen && vitest run -c vitest.bench.config.ts
